subject: Kathak (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: History of Indian Dance
topics: A brief history of Indian dance

chapters.name: Themes and Legends in Kathak
topics: Ramayana, Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana and Gita Govinda in the context of Kathak
Kalia daman, Govardhan lila, Panghat lila, Draupadi cheer haran, Makhan chori, Marich vadh, Bhasmasur vadh, Madan dahan

chapters.name: History of Kathak
topics: Mandir kal (kathavachak, rasdhari), Darbar kal, modern era

chapters.name: Kathak Repertoire
topics: Abhinaya: bhajan, thumri, dadra, ghazal, dhrupad, kavit

chapters.name: Kathak Terminology (Class XI)
topics: Nritta, nritya, natya, tandava, lasya, anga, upanga, pratyanga

chapters.name: Tatkar and Basic Positions
topics: Basic standing position; patterns of tatkar
Tatkar in teentaal in thah, dugun, chaugun

chapters.name: Body Exercises and Chakkars
topics: Ten hastak movements and chakkars in teentaal

chapters.name: Parhant with Hasta Kriya
topics: Teentaal and jhaptaal in thah, dugun, chaugun

chapters.name: Kathak Compositions (Class XI)
topics: Thaat, aamad, tez aamad, vandana, tukra/toda, natwari tukra, gatnikas, gatbhaav, paran, tihaayi, ladi/laya baant, parhant of tukda
